## 2. FINANCIAL-LEAK GAP LIST (ranked, critical first)

### CRITICAL

**C1 — Public token pages leak all financials/payroll to every internal role (and any token-holder).** *Pages: PublicLedger, PublicEmployeeLedger, PublicReimbursable, QuoteApproval · Roles: tech, user, manager (+ any).* These 4 routes render **outside** `ProtectedRoute` and read Firestore via the browser SDK with zero RBAC — any authenticated tech/user/manager opening a `/ledger/:token`, `/employee-statement/:token`, or `/reimbursable/:token` URL sees full client ledgers, vendor PO cost/margins, or **any employee's payroll (payouts + advances)**. QuoteApproval also does an unauthenticated `updateDoc` to confirm/reject projects. **Fix:** convert all four to token-validated Cloud Functions mirroring `getPortalData` (Admin SDK validates token+expiry+enabled, returns only scoped payload); strip all client-SDK `getDocs`/`updateDoc`; do **not** add a public token read rule to `firestore.rules`.

**C2 — Accounting suite fully open to manager.** *Pages: Accounting, BankReconciliation, RecurringEntries · Role: manager.* `/accounting` is guarded by `resource="finance"` whose view includes manager, so the whole double-entry suite (P&L, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, GST/GSTR, TDS, all party ledgers, full journal, bank statement + reconciliation, all exports incl. Tally) is reachable and exportable by managers. RecurringEntries additionally lets manager **create/post GL vouchers** (`canEdit = finance.edit||finance.create`, both include manager). **Fix:** add dedicated `accounting` resource `{view/edit/post: ['admin','accountant']}`; re-point the `/accounting` route; remove manager from `finance.create/edit`; gate exports + RecurringEntries `canEdit` on the new resource; back with firestore rules on the finance collections.

**C3 — Company-wide financial reports open to manager.** *Pages: Reports, BusinessReport, DailyReport, Analytics, AssetAnalytics · Role: manager.* Every one is an un-owner-scoped company-wide P&L/margin/GST/ledger/asset-ROI console reachable via `reports.view`/`daily_reports.view` (both include manager). Manager sees other clients' receivables, other projects' margins, vendor costs, all-employee ledgers, GST liability, blended ROI, top-clients-by-revenue, and can PDF/Excel-export all of it. **Fix:** remove manager from `reports.view` and `daily_reports.view`; split Analytics/AssetAnalytics/BusinessReport onto their own admin/accountant-only resources (they currently piggyback `reports`) so the change is surgical.

**C4 — Clients & Vendors financial dashboard open to Coordinator (user).** *Page: Clients · Role: user.* `clients.view` includes `user`; the loader only owner-scopes `manager`, and `canSeeAllClients = role!=='manager'` is **true** for user — so a Coordinator sees the full financial dashboard for ALL parties: lifetime revenue, invoiced/received/outstanding/overdue, per-branch billed, GST, invoice register, payment history, and the entire **Vendor Account** (PO costs + vendor payments). **Fix:** remove `user` from `clients.view`; make `canSeeAllClients = admin||accountant`; gate the whole Dashboard tab + Vendor Account behind `finance.view`; back with a firestore read rule (admin/accountant all, manager owner-scoped).

**C5 — Inventory rental/purchase rates leak to Coordinator (user).** *Page: Inventory · Role: user.* Rate/Day column + entire Commercial tab (daily/weekly rate, purchase cost, replacement value, GST, HSN) are gated on `role !== 'tech'` instead of `view_rates`, so `user` sees all rates; the **Suppliers tab per-vendor rate has no gate at all** (leaks to user **and** tech). **Fix:** replace `role!=='tech'` with `can(role,'inventory','view_rates')` on the rate column, Commercial tab, and Suppliers-tab rate; per target model remove `manager` from `inventory.view_rates` (→ `['admin','accountant']`).

**C6 — Expenses Tracker/Employee-Dashboard leaks all payroll to manager.** *Page: Expenses · Role: manager.* Tracker + Employee Dashboard tabs (gated by hardcoded `role==='admin'||role==='manager'`) expose **every** employee's payouts/SALARY, advances, and net balances company-wide with no owner scope, plus other projects' expense amounts. **Fix:** replace hardcoded tab gate with `can(role,'expenses','view_all')`; owner-scope manager's tracker/approvals/empDash to own-project expenses; gate all payout/salary/advance/net-balance cells behind a payroll capability (`['admin','accountant']`).

**C7 — HRReports re-exposes payroll + company P&L to manager.** *Page: HRReports · Role: manager.* Even though `hr_payroll` is correctly admin/accountant-only, `hr_reports.view/export` include manager, and Report 7 (Payroll Summary: rate/gross/deductions/net for every employee) and Report 9 (Employee Financial Performance: per-employee revenue/cost/net-benefit/ROI + company totals + per-project revenue shares) are not role-gated. Manager can also export both. **Fix:** remove manager from `hr_reports.view` and `hr_reports.export` (match `hr_payroll`); OR keep operational HR reports for manager but hard-gate reports 7 & 9 (render + `buildReportTable`/export cases) behind a new `hr_reports.view_financials=['admin','accountant']`.

**C8 — AppAssistant answers company-wide financial queries for manager + leaks inventory rates to tech/user.** *Component: AppAssistant · Roles: manager, tech, user.* Financial intents gate on `can(role,'reports','view')` which includes manager → manager gets company P&L, cash position, all-client receivables/payables, all-employee expenses, margin BI over the full unscoped dataset. Separately, `inventorySearch`/`inventoryByCategory` emit `rate_per_day` with no gate → tech/user see rental rates. **Fix:** split intents into COMPANY_FINANCIAL (gate `finance.view && role!=='manager'`) and OWN_SCOPED (ownership-checked); thread `currentUserId`/owned ids into `execCtx`; strip `rate_per_day` from inventory executors unless `view_rates`.

### HIGH

**H1 — Purchase Invoices: whole company purchase book open to manager.** *Page: PurchaseInvoices · Role: manager.* `purchase_invoices.view/create/edit` include manager; page shows every vendor's cost, ITC/GST, totals, cash-vs-credit mode, GSTINs, PO-cost supersession, scanned bills — no owner tie exists to scope on. **Fix:** set `purchase_invoices` view/create/edit → `['admin','accountant']` (delete already is); replace hardcoded `role==='admin'||role==='manager'` UI gates with `can()`; firestore read rule admin/accountant-only.

**H2 — Projects: non-owner manager sees invoice card + can generate Tax/Proforma invoice PDFs.** *Page: Projects · Role: manager.* Invoice card, `generateTaxInvoicePDF`, Proforma create/print are gated by role-wide `canManageProjectInvoices` (`projects.invoice`) instead of the owner-scoped `canViewProjectFinancials` — leaking a non-owned project's invoice no/status/dates/remarks and full-amount PDFs. **Fix:** AND every invoice UI gate + handler with `canViewProjectFinancials`; early-return the PDF/save handlers when `!canViewProjectFinancials`.

**H3 — Outsourcing: non-owner (assigned-only) manager sees full vendor/PO costs.** *Page: Outsourcing · Role: manager.* For projects the manager is assigned to but doesn't own, PO amounts, per-item rate/days/GST, allocation totals, cost breakdown, Service-PI amounts, and PI-vs-PO margin all render; the money guards are a dead `role!=='tech'` check. **Fix:** add `canSeePOFinancials(project) = admin||accountant||(manager && project.client_owner_id===currentEmpId)`; pass `currentEmpId` (App.jsx omits it today); gate all money renders + PDF exports; owner-check per-row in the combined all-POs view.

**H4 — Tax Invoices: manager sees all clients' invoices + company sales total.** *Page: TaxInvoices · Role: manager.* No owner filter — manager sees every client's final amounts/GST split/GSTIN, the company-wide "Total" chip, and all unbilled-project values. **Fix:** owner-scope `taxInvoices`/`unbilledProjects`/client options to `client.owner_id===currentEmpId` for manager; recompute totals over the scoped set; denormalize `owner_id` onto invoice docs + firestore rule.

**H5 — Leads: manager sees all managers' deal values + company pipeline; tech/user can SDK-read leads.** *Page: Leads · Roles: manager, tech, user.* Loader fetches the whole collection; `est_value` per card + "Open Pipeline" sum + "Win Rate" span all owners. `leads` has no dedicated firestore rule so the generic wildcard lets tech/user read the raw collection. **Fix:** owner-scope manager to `created_by===currentEmpId`; compute pipeline/winrate from own leads; add a dedicated firestore `leads` rule excluding it from the wildcard (admin/accountant all, manager own, tech/user none).

**H6 — Challans: priced PDF (rate + amount + duration) exportable by tech/user/non-owner manager.** *Page: ChallanManager · Roles: tech, user, manager.* `allChallans` iterates ALL projects unscoped; the printed challan PDF always includes per-item rate/amount/HSN/GSTIN. **Fix:** add `challans.view_amounts=['admin','accountant','manager']`; build a non-priced PDF (drop rate/amount columns) when `!showMoney`; owner-scope manager rows; ideally stop persisting rate/total in the challan snapshot at creation.

**H7 — DocumentsHub: PO amounts/cost-breakdown/proforma totals leak to tech and non-owner manager.** *Page: DocumentsHub · Roles: tech, manager.* `documents.view` includes tech; the projects loader puts tech in the global (all-projects) branch → tech sees every PO amount, per-item amounts, full cost breakdown, PI grand totals, and can Export PDF. Manager sees the same for non-owned assigned projects. **Fix:** remove `tech` from `documents.view`; make the page owner-aware (`isOwnProject`) and blank amounts/cost-breakdown/PI-total for non-owned; apply same predicate to the PDF export.

**H8 — Dashboard: manager's money aggregates + overdue receivables span all clients/assigned projects.** *Page: Dashboard · Role: manager.* Overdue-60 KPI sums the full un-scoped `tax_invoices`; Revenue/TopProjects/chart include assigned-but-not-owned projects. (Also the `/dashboard` route is the only route with **no** `ProtectedRoute` wrapper.) **Fix:** scope overdue60 + every money aggregation to owned projects for manager; wrap `/dashboard` in a `ProtectedRoute` (e.g. `hr_portal` or a new `dashboard` resource = all 5).

**H9 — NotificationBell: unpaid-invoice outstanding + client names span all clients for manager.** *Component: NotificationBell · Role: manager.* The unpaid-invoice block is gated by a hardcoded `['admin','manager','accountant']` array with no owner filter → manager sees receivables + client identity company-wide. **Fix:** owner-scope the unpaid block for manager; replace literal role arrays with `can()`.

**H10 — HRAttendance: manager sees + mutates all employees' attendance/penalties (not own+team).** *Page: HRAttendance · Role: manager.* `filteredLogs`/`filteredPenalties`/shift-requests are unscoped; manager can force-close/adjust/delete/penalize **any** employee. **Fix:** scope lists + write handlers to the manager's team (`reportsTo/managerId===currentEmpId`); firestore rule enforcing team scope.

**H11 — HRLeaves: Balances tab leaks every employee's leave balance to tech/user.** *Page: HRLeaves · Roles: tech, user.* The `balances` memo maps over all employees and is not gated by `canViewAll` (only the Requests list is own-filtered). **Fix:** gate/filter the Balances tab to self when `!canViewAll`; fix the company-wide Pending badge to count only visible records; scope manager to own+team.

**H12 — Employees: hourly rate + salary history + advances + PII exposed to tech/user; unscoped for manager.** *Page: Employees · Roles: tech, user, manager.* `employees.view` includes all 5 roles → tech/user see every colleague's hourly rate, rate-history, and full PII (mobiles, address, ID-proof URLs, ID-card PDF). Manager sees all salaries company-wide (no team scope). **Fix:** set `employees.view=['admin','accountant','manager']`; add `employees.view_pay=['admin','accountant','manager']` gating rate/advances/promotion/ledger; owner/team-scope manager; firestore rule stripping rate/PII for non-authorized.

**H13 — Accounting finance collections SDK-readable by tech/user behind the page.** *Data layer · Roles: tech, user.* The firestore wildcard read lets any non-anonymous role read `journal_entries`, `payments`, `payouts`, `vendor_payments`, `tax_invoices`, `purchase_invoices`, `chart_of_accounts`, `opening_balances`, etc. directly. **Fix:** exclude the finance collection set from the wildcard and add explicit admin/accountant read rules (manager only where owner-scoped).

### MEDIUM

**M1 — Chat: blanket cross-project/DM read for manager is a financial-leak channel.** *Page: Chat · Role: manager.* `chatCanRead` grants manager read of ALL project rooms + all DMs, so any invoice/quote/payroll pasted or attached anywhere is visible. **Fix:** narrow `chatCanRead`/`channelMembers` so manager reads only owned/assigned/member rooms; consider restricting non-image attachment types.

**M2 — Finance page write (finance.create) lets manager record payments against any client.** *Page: Finance · Role: manager.* Beyond the view leak (folded into C-tier removal), `finance.create` includes manager → can record incoming payments against any client. **Fix:** remove manager from `finance.create`; if own-client receipts needed, add scoped `finance.create_own_receipt` used by an owner-scoped mini-form only.

**M3 — Expenses Payments tab shows own SALARY/payout statement to tech/user.** *Page: Expenses · Roles: tech, user (+ user Ledger).* Own payout/SALARY statement + payout-derived KPIs render for tech/user, who per target get no payroll visibility. **Fix:** gate the Payments tab + payout KPI cards behind a new `expenses.view_payments=['admin','accountant','manager']`.

**M4 — AuditLogs: full security/admin surveillance trail visible to accountant + raw payload dump.** *Page: AuditLogs · Role: accountant.* `audit_logs.view` includes accountant, exposing RBAC/impersonation/lockout events + `JSON.stringify(log.details)` raw mutation payloads (financial values, PII). **Fix:** tighten `audit_logs.view=['admin']`; render a whitelisted summary instead of raw JSON; admin-only firestore read rule.

**M5 — HRDashboard: manager sees company-wide attendance/geo analytics (not own+team).** *Page: HRDashboard · Role: manager.* No money, but attendance/compliance/geo-exception/location-pie/penalty data spans the whole workforce. **Fix:** pass team-filtered data (or role+empId to self-scope) for manager; firestore team-scope on timeLogs/penalties/leaves.

### LOW / DEFENSE-IN-DEPTH

- **L1 Commission** — UI correctly own-scopes manager/user; residual: loader ships all payments/payouts and rules are generic-read. Scope loader + add owner rules.
- **L2 Projects/Schedule/Challans operational over-exposure** — tech/user can open any project's operational detail (not just assigned). Filter by assignment.
- **L3 AdminTools org doc** — `organization` settings doc (bank account_no/IFSC/UPI, `gst_api_key`, GSTIN/PAN) is broadly readable; split secrets into an admin-only doc.
- **L4 DataPortal gate fragility** — export path has no in-component admin check and hinges on RBAC-editable `admin_tools`; add a dedicated `data_portal` resource + explicit `handleExport` guard.
- **L5 WarehouseScan under-permissioning** — tech is *meant* to scan but `canEdit` resolves admin+manager only. Add `inventory.scan_movement=['admin','manager','tech']` (not a leak, a functional gap).
- **L6 Chat accountant sidebar/rule mismatch** — `visibleProjects` treats accountant as mgmt but `chatCanRead` doesn't; remove accountant from the mgmt flag.
